responsibilities: Own product analytics across the different product lines: define, track success metrics and respective targets while ensuring alignment with overall Product and Company strategy.
Influence Decision-Making: Use a deep understanding of our product, users, and business to craft compelling data stories that guide product leaders in critical decisions.
Build reusable, scalable data products: collaborate with other engineers in developing data products that enable self-service analytics and democratize data access.

Build a governed self-service layer: define practices on event instrumentation & taxonomy for our event-driven architecture and self-service analytics tooling and enable Product and GTM peers on event instrumentation and insight generation.
Drive Data Literacy: Evangelize the use of data and empower teams to self-serve insights by increasing data literacy through enablement and close partnership.

Work AI-native: Continuously evaluate where LLMs and AI tooling can compress your workflow — from query generation to dashboard building to insight synthesis — and apply them deliberately to increase the speed and scope of what you and the team deliver.
Work cross-functionally with GTM: connect product usage to commercial outcomes (win/loss, expansion, renewal) and scale repeatable analyses/automations.
